Title: Tamanna AI
Short: The supervisory AI that orchestrates agents and auto-fixes code.
Content: Tamanna AI provides automated pipelines, configurable fixers, and reporting. It is designed to minimize manual work while keeping humans in the loop for failed builds.

Title: bd-king-r7 AI
Short: AI components specific to the bd-king-r7 powerhub product.
Content: Provides firmware build automation, test harness orchestration, and power management simulation tooling.

Title: Tamanna System
Short: Full automation system: agents, orchestrator, dashboard.
Content: Agents run per-host tasks; the orchestrator stores run records and provides a dashboard. Start with push disabled and a dedicated automation branch.
